notes: Seeds 1-6 are guaranteed playoff spots in each conference.
Seeds 7-10 enter the Play-In Tournament to determine seeds 7 and 8.

final_game.matchup: Loser of Game 1 hosts Winner of Game 2

notes: Seeds 7 and 8 can qualify by winning one game; seeds 9 and 10 must win two games.

team_fields.divisionWins: number (required only if division_win_pct may apply)
team_fields.divisionLosses: number (required only if division_win_pct may apply)

notes: For multi-way ties, head_to_head should include results against all tied teams.
Missing matchup data should be treated as an error in the resolver.

playoff_eligible_teams.definition: Teams that finished the regular season tied for one of the best 10 records in their conference.

head_to_head.label: Better head-to-head winning percentage (two-way) or winning percentage in games among tied teams (multi-way)

division_winner.label: Division winner ranks higher than teams not leading a division

applies_when.two_way: only if teams are in same division
applies_when.multi_way: only if all tied teams are in same division

vs_playoff_own_conf.label: Better winning percentage vs playoff-eligible teams in own conference

vs_playoff_other_conf.label: Better winning percentage vs playoff-eligible teams in opposite conference

point_differential.label: Better net points (points scored minus points allowed)

guidelines: Ties to determine division winners must be broken before any other ties.
When a tie must be broken to determine a division winner, the results of the tie-break are used only to determine the division winner.
For multi-team ties, apply the criteria in order until the tie is completely or partially broken.
If partially broken, teams still tied restart from the beginning of the applicable criteria list.
If no criteria break the tie, playoff positions are determined by random drawing.
